claims.text: A police impersonation scam ring operating from 2026-01-06 to 2026-08-01 targeted 149 victims across Nepal, impersonating 'Inspector Shrestha' and other officers from the Central Investigation Bureau to extort NPR 47,649,000 through 'digital arrest' threats. Victims were kept on hours-long video calls and pressured to pay security deposits into two Morivan Finance bank accounts and three IME Pay wallets.
claims.reason: Evidence matches victim count, loss, dates, scam type.

claims.text: Caller initiates contact via WhatsApp or phone call claiming to be 'Inspector Shrestha' (or Officer Prakash, Rajendra, Ramesh Thapa) from the Central Investigation Bureau.
claims.reason: Names appear in complaints and examples show initiation via WhatsApp/phone.

claims.text: Caller claims a parcel in the victim's name has been intercepted containing illegal items (drugs, banned substances) and threatens 'digital arrest' or physical arrest unless a security deposit is paid immediately.
claims.reason: Complaints describe parcel with illegal items and demand security deposit.

claims.text: Caller keeps victim on continuous video call for hours, using pressure, threats, fake documents, and refusal to let victim hang up to induce fear and compliance.
claims.reason: Multiple complaints mention hours-long video calls, pressure, refusal to hang up.

claims.text: Victim is directed to transfer a security deposit to one of two Morivan Finance bank accounts (6562588153714732 held by 'Anil S.' or 9447364710276773 held by 'Sagar G.') or to an IME Pay wallet (969555426, 980555509, or 969555271).
claims.reason: Lead data and complaint excerpts show transfers to specified accounts/wallets.
Lead entries list each phone with counts; examples show their use in combination.

claims.text: Victims across multiple districts (Kathmandu, Kaski, Kailali, Sunsari, Morang, Parsa, Chitwan, Rupandehi, Bhaktapur, Banke, Rupandehi, Lalitpur) are targeted over a seven-month period with median loss NPR 227,000 and maximum single loss NPR 890,500.

open_questions: Whether the three predictor-linked complaints (CMP-00813, CMP-01119, CMP-01221) are definitively part of this ring or represent a separate but similar operation.
The true identities of the account holders 'Anil S.' and 'Sagar G.' for the two Morivan Finance accounts, and whether they are complicit or identity-theft victims.
Who controls the 11 phone numbers and three IME Pay wallets, and whether they are operated by a single group or multiple coordinated cells.
